remarks: Move right in to this beautifully updated townhouse offering 3 levels of stylish, modern living just moments from downtown. Featuring an open floor plan with fresh paint and gleaming hardwood floors, this home is filled with natural light and high-end finishes throughout. The new custom kitchen showcases sleek modern cabinetry, new appliances, and stunning details designed for today's lifestyle. All bathrooms have been fully renovated with contemporary fixtures, tile, and finishes, including a spa-like primary suite with a luxurious modern bath. Additional highlights include new lighting, hardware, windows, interior and exterior doors, plus a new roof on the complex. Enjoy outdoor living with a new Azek front porch and back deck. The finished walk-out lower level offers a 3rd bedroom/bonus room and full laundry room, perfect to double as home office, gym, or media space. An attached garage completes the package. Conveniently located near downtown shopping, restaurants, train station, and major highways-this home truly has it all. Nothing to do but move in and enjoy.
